description_en: Turns on or turns off logon-free sharing for an application monitored by Browser Monitoring
description_zh: 打开或关闭前端监控站点的免登录分享开关，打开该功能后即可通过调用GetRetcodeShareUrl接口获取的地址访问前端监控页面
kebab_example: aliyun arms set-retcode-share-status --pid atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf0000 --status true --app-name test-app --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetRetcodeShareStatus

parameters.help_en:
The process identifier (PID) of the application. 

Log on to the **ARMS console**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Browser Monitoring** > **Browser Monitoring**. On the Browser Monitoring page, click the name of an application. The URL in the address bar contains the process ID (PID) of the application. The PID is indicated in the `pid=xxx` format. The PID is usually percent encoded as `xxx%40xxx`. You must modify this value to remove the percent encoding. For example, if the PID in the URL is `eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****`, you must replace `%40` with @ to obtain `eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****`
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在**ARMS控制台**的**前端监控** > **前端列表**页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含前端应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，应用需要对xxx%40xxx格式的pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为eb4zdose6v%409781be0f44d****，则需要将%40替换为@，即：eb4zdose6v@9781be0f44d****
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to turn on or turn off the logon-free sharing switch. Valid values:

*   `true`: Turn on the switch.
*   `false`: Turn off the switch
parameters.help_zh:
设置前端监控站点的免登录分享开关的状态。取值：

- `true`：开启。
- `false`：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the application that is monitored by Browser Monitoring
parameters.name: app_name
